paite: Ahehna chiang a gimthuakna mu keimah ka hi.
heading: Gawtna, Kisikna Leh Lametna
english: I am the man that has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

paite: Khovak ah hilou in khomial ah ama'n hon pi in, ahon vaksak hi.
english: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.

paite: Nitum in ka siatna ding in akhut ahei ahei petmah hi.
english: Surely against me he turns his hand again and again all the day.

paite: Ka sa leh ka vun a-upasak a; ka guhte akitansak hi.
english: My flesh and my skin has he made old; he has broken my bones.

paite: Ka siatna ding in alam a, khatna leh nauveina in ahon umsuak hi.
english: He has built against me, and surrounded me with gall and travail.

paite: Sawtpi a sisate bang in, mun mialte ah ahon tengsak hi.
english: He has made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.

paite: Ka pawtkhiak theihlouhna ding in, ka kimvel in dai akai a, ka khainiang agik hi.
english: He has walled me about, that I can’t go forth; he has made my chain heavy.

paite: Ahi, ka kah a, panpihna ka nget lai in, ka thumna adaltan hi.
english: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.

paite: Suangsek in ka lampite dai akaitou a, ka lam zuihte akawisak hi.
english: He has walled up my ways with cut stone; he has made my paths crooked.

paite: Kei a ding in amah vompi mibuk leh mun-guk a humpinelkai bang ahi.
english: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in secret places.

paite: Ka lampite akaihei a, ahon botnen a; ahon bawlgawp hi.
english: He has turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces; he has made me desolate.

paite: Athalpeu alai a, athal a dia ngim ding in kei ahon bawl hi.
english: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

paite: Athalbawm a thalte ka lungtang ah alutsak a,
english: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.

paite: Ka mite tengteng nuihsan ka hong hi; ni tumtum a ala uh.
english: I am become a derision to all my people, and their song all the day.

paite: Hehna in ahon dimsak ua, gamsai in ahon vak uhi.
english: He has filled me with bitterness, he has sated me with wormwood.

paite: Suangtat in ka hate leng akitamsak a, vut in ahon tuam hi.
english: He has also broken my teeth with gravel stones; he has covered me with ashes.

paite: Muanna a kipan gamlapi ah ka kha na suan a; hauhsakna ka mangngilhta.
english: You have removed my soul far off from peace; I forgot prosperity.

paite: Ka hatna amang a, TOUPA a kipan ka lametna, ka chi a.
english: I said, My strength is perished, and my expectation from Yahweh.

paite: Ka gimthuakna leh ka haksatna, gamsai leh khatna theigige in.
english: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

paite: Ka kha in amaute atheigige a, ka sung ah akun ngiungiau hi.
english: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.

paite: Hiai ka thei thaka, huaiziak in lametna ka nei hi.
english: This I recall to my mind; therefore have I hope.

paite: TOUPA zahngaihnate ziak ahi hihmang a i om louh uh; alainatnate azuau ngei louh ziak in.
english: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail.

paite: Zingsang teng in athak zel ua; na ginomna athupi hi.
english: They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.

paite: TOUPA ka tantuan ahi, ka kha in achi; huaiziak in amah ah lametna ka nei ding.
english: Yahweh is my portion, says my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

paite: Amah ngakte kiang ah TOUPA ahoih, amah zongmi tung ah.
english: Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul that seeks him.

paite: Mi'n TOUPA hotdamna a lamet angak vengveng ahoih hi.
english: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.

paite: Mi'n atuailai a hakkol apuak amah a ding in ahoih ahi.
english: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

paite: Amah tung a angak tak ziak in, tangtut henla, dai sipsip hen.
english: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.

paite: Leivui ah akam koih hen; huchi a lametna a-omtheihna ding in.
english: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if so be there may be hope.

paite: Amah bengpa kiang ah abiang doh hen; kouna in amah dimvum hen.
english: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him; let him be filled full with reproach.

paite: Toupa'n lah tangtawn in adelh kei ding a.
english: For the Lord will not cast off forever.

paite: Dahna suaksak mahleh, azahngaihna tamdan dungzui in lainatna anei ding hi.
english: For though he cause grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

paite: Kilawptak in mite tate hihgim hiam lungkhamsak hiam ahi kei hi.
english: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.

paite: Lei a suangkul tangte tengteng khenuai sikkham ding,
english: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,

paite: Tungnungpen maima a mihing thuneihna kaihei ding in.
english: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the Most High,

paite: Athu a mihing bawlsiat, Toupa'n pha asa kei.
english: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.

paite: Toupa'n thu apiak louh in, hichi ahong hi, chi kua ahia?
english: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?

paite: Tungnungpen kam a kipan in hoih lou leh hoih ahong pai kei maw?
english: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?

paite: Bangziak a mihing, akhelhna gawtna a ding a mi phun ahia?
english: Why does a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

paite: I lampite zong in enchian ni, huan TOUPA lam ah kik nawn ni.
english: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Yahweh.

paite: Vante a Pathian kiang ah i lungtang leh i khutte liktou ni;
english: Let us lift up our heart with our hands to God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” in the heavens.

paite: Ka tatlek ua ka hel uh; na ngaidam kei hi.
english: We have transgressed and have rebelled; you have not pardoned.

paite: Hehna in na khuh a, kou na hon delh a, that in, na hehpih kei hi.
english: You have covered with anger and pursued us; you have killed, you have not pitied.

paite: Meipi in na kituam a, huchi a ka thumna in apailetlouhna ding in.
english: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.

paite: Mite lak ah deih louh leh ninneng bang in na hon bawl hi.
english: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the midst of the peoples.

paite: Ka siatna ding in ka melma tengteng un akam uh lianpi in aka uh.
english: All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.

paite: Launa leh kokhuk ka tung uah ahong tung a, siatgawpna leh siatna.
english: Fear and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.

paite: Ka mite tanu suksiatna ziak in, ka mit tui in atum hi.
english: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

paite: Khawl lou in, ka mit in abuak a, akhawl kei hi.
english: My eye pours down, and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,

paite: Van a kipan TOUPA'N a-etsuk a, amuh matan
english: Until Yahweh look down, and see from heaven.

paite: ka khopi tanute tengteng ziak in ka mit in ka kha adahsak.
english: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.

paite: Vasa bang in ahon delhbah ua, aziak bei a ka melma hite'n.
english: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.

paite: Leikohawm sung ah ka hinna asattat ua, ka tung ah suang akhia uhi.
english: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.

paite: Ka lutung ah tuite aluang a; satkhiak in ka om, ka chi hi.
english: Waters flowed over my head; I said, I am cut off.

paite: Aw TOUPA, leikohawm niampen a pan in, na min ka sam hi.
english: I called on your name, Yahweh, out of the lowest dungeon.

paite: Ka aw na za a; ka kahna ah, ka nakna ah na bil sel ke'n.
english: You heard my voice; don’t hide your ear at my breathing, at my cry.

paite: Nang ka hon sap ni in na hong pai nai a, "Lau ke'n!" na chỉ hi.
english: You drew near in the day that I called on you; you said, Don’t be afraid.

paite: Aw TOUPA, ka kha thu na hon gensak a; ka hinna na tanta hi.
english: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul; you have redeemed my life.

paite: Aw TOUPA, ka diklouhna na mu a, ka thu ngaihtuah in.
english: Yahweh, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.

paite: Ka tung a aphulakna tengteng uleh athusawm tengteng uh na muta hi.
english: You have seen all their vengeance and all their devices against me.

paite: Akouna uh na za a, Aw TOUPA, ka siatna ding a athusawm tengteng uh.
english: You have heard their reproach, Yahweh, and all their devices against me,

paite: Ka siatna ding a dinghte mukte leh nitum a ka siatna ding a angaihtuahna uh.
english: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.

paite: Atut uleh adintouh uh nang en in; ala uh ka hi.
english: You see their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their song.

paite: Aw TOUPA, akhut nasep dungzui in, atung uah thuk in.
english: You will render to them a recompense, Yahweh, according to the work of their hands.

paite: Lungtang lungkhamna leh na hamsia atung uah pia inla,
english: You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.

paite: heh in amau na delh ding a TOUPA vante nuai a kipan amaute na hihgawp ding hi.
english: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Yahweh.
